Name: Ishui, Son of Saul
Summary: Ishui is listed among Saul's sons in 1 Samuel 14 (also rendered Ishvi). Some readers identify him with Ish-bosheth, also called Eshbaal, but the Samuel text names them in different passages and they are kept separate here.
KeyStory: Ishui is named once, among Saul's sons, and then disappears from the record.
LifeLesson: Some lives are recorded in a single verse — and still counted.
